title: Backplane
excerpt: A TOTALLY open-source workspace for agentic hardware development.
content_html:
backplane

the default for agentic CAD

curl -fsSL https://backplaneworks.com/install.sh | sh

  1. Backplane uses AGENTS to design HARDWARE.
  2. Backplane is FREE AND OPEN SOURCE FOREVER.
  3. Backplane is a KiCad fork.
  4. Backplane is created + maintained by real electrical engineers.
